import os
import pytest
import ops
from ops.model import _ModelBackend


def fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, name, script):
    path = bin_dir / name
    path.write_text('#!/bin/sh\n' + script + '\n')
    path.chmod(0o755)


def test_permission_denied_maps_to_relation_not_found(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bin_dir = tmp_path / 'bin'
    bin_dir.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv('PATH', str(bin_dir) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
    monkeypatch.setenv('JUJU_VERSION', '3.6.0')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-ids', 'echo \'["dbc:1"]\'')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-list', 'echo \'["provider/0"]\'')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'is-leader', 'echo true')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-get', "echo 'ERROR permission denied' >&2; exit 1")
    model = ops.Model(ops.CharmMeta.from_yaml('name: myapp\nrequires:\n  dbc: {interface: dbc}\n'), _ModelBackend('myapp/0'))
    try:
        model.relations['dbc'][0].data[model.relations['dbc'][0].app]
    except ops.RelationNotFoundError:
        pass
    except Exception as e:
        pytest.fail(f'Expected RelationNotFoundError, got {type(e)}')
